svg.title: Luxury Pakistani villa at golden hour
svg.desc: A wide premium hero scene: a modern two-storey luxury villa on the right with warm glowing windows, a double-height glazed entrance, stone cladding and a cantilevered upper floor, behind a boundary wall and sliding gate, with palms, trees, a striped lawn and a paved driveway under a golden-hour sunset sky. The left half is kept calm and darker for headline text.
